supersededBy: docs/handoffs/image-gen/09-openai-provider.json — current predicate uses openai; branch/user-disable behavior preserved
recordScope: Initial runtime matrix is historical. The production predicate and ownership restoration were corrected for the existing image subscription; current boundary checks/native load are in 08.

modules.wiring: packages/pi-codex-image-gen/src/index.ts: session_start resets the in-memory state and applies the decision; before_agent_start applies the decision then filters the skill when the tool is not active

predicate: ctx.modelRegistry.getProviderAuthStatus('openai-codex').configured === true, no network or token refresh; openai-only credentials do not enable the image tool

decisionTable.notRegistered: do nothing (tools removed by --tools/--exclude-tools/--no-tools never appear in getAllTools())
decisionTable.activeAndMissing: setActiveTools(active without image_gen) + record { hiddenByExtension: true }
decisionTable.inactiveAndConfigured: re-enable only if the latest branch record (fallback: in-memory state) says hiddenByExtension: true; then setActiveTools(active + image_gen) + record { hiddenByExtension: false }
decisionTable.otherTools: only image_gen is added or removed; existing order preserved

branchRecord.written: on hidden/re-enabled ownership transitions; restored active state clears a stale true record so a later user disable is not undone
branchRecord.read: latest custom entry of this type in getBranch; in-memory fallback resets at session_start and to the current branch record on session_tree

skillFilter: in before_agent_start, when image_gen is not active after the decision, event.systemPromptOptions.skills is reassigned without the 'imagegen' entry; skills are never added; /skill:imagegen still loads when invoked explicitly

observedMatrix.login: Native local Pi 1.0.2: existing subscription resolves, production image_gen registered/active, package imagegen listed (08 native-load log).
observedMatrix.apiKey: Public-provider credentials do not satisfy the production subscription predicate; no openai/public credential fallback (08 boundary checks; no live call).
observedMatrix.none: Missing subscription hides image_gen and filters imagegen; other tools/skills remain (existing decision checks and 08 lifecycle harness).
observedMatrix.userDisabled: With subscription present, an inactive tool not owned by this extension stays inactive and its skill is removed (08 lifecycle harness).
observedMatrix.excluded: Absent registration is untouched and no entry is written (existing 05 check).
observedMatrix.loginMidSession: Subscription flag false -> true re-enables only an extension-hidden tool, then records false (08 lifecycle harness).
observedMatrix.treeAndResume: Current branch replaces stale in-memory ownership; active restored state clears old true ownership before a later user disable (08 lifecycle harness, not an interactive tree test).

initialPublicApiMatrix.login: stored ChatGPT sign-in: image_gen active at session_start and before_agent_start, skills=[imagegen], 0 exposure entries
initialPublicApiMatrix.apiKey: temporary PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR + OPENAI_API_KEY: configured {source:'environment', label:'OPENAI_API_KEY'}, image_gen active, skills=[imagegen], 0 entries
initialPublicApiMatrix.none: temporary PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR without credentials: image_gen inactive from session_start, skills=[] in before_agent_start, 1 entry {hiddenByExtension:true}; /skill:imagegen still expanded into the prompt and the model answered with the /login / OPENAI_API_KEY guidance
initialPublicApiMatrix.userDisabled: scratch extension removed image_gen at session_start with credentials present: stays inactive, skills=[], 0 entries
initialPublicApiMatrix.excluded: -xt image_gen: not registered, nothing written, skills=[]
initialPublicApiMatrix.loginMidSession: two prompts in one session; a scratch extension registered a runtime openai apiKey after the first run: prompt 1 inactive/skills=[] with entry true, prompt 2 active/skills=[imagegen] with entry false (simulates /login)

piBehaviors.setActiveToolsInBeforeAgentStart: observed: the change applied to the same prompt's declaration (pi 1.0.2; agent-session.js keeps the live loadout when handlers call setActiveTools)
piBehaviors.skillsMutation: observed: reassigning event.systemPromptOptions.skills removed the skill from the rendered prompt
piBehaviors.resumeReload: Pi re-activates extension tools (includeAllExtensionTools) and fires session_start, where the decision re-runs; not exercised live
piBehaviors.tree: /tree restores tools from the transcript; the branch record then distinguishes extension-hidden from user-disabled; exercised only in the stubbed decision tests (branch record true -> re-enabled; latest false -> stays off)
